summary: Pinnacle Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting two post-IPO events: on September 21, 2026, the sponsor PAC Sponsor, LLC forfeited and cancelled 750,000 Class B ordinary shares after the underwriters' 45-day over-allotment option expired unexercised, leaving the sponsor with 20.0% of outstanding ordinary shares; and, effective September 25, 2026, unit holders may separately trade the Class A shares (PNAQ) and rights (PNAQ.RT), with unseparated units continuing as PNAQ.U. No deal terms or business-combination target were disclosed. Watch for a target announcement and any redemption or extension mechanics.
